subject: Money
title: Rug Pulls
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Rug Pulls.

hook.text: Squid Game token surged 75,000% in days. Investors couldn't sell. The creators drained $3.4 million and vanished.

buildup.text: A rug pull: developers create a token, hype it, attract investors, then drain the liquidity pool and disappear.

discovery.text: In 2021, rug pulls stole $7.7 billion from crypto investors. Most targeted DeFi projects on Ethereum and Binance Chain.

twist.text: Many rug pulls are technically legal because crypto is lightly regulated. Victims have almost no legal recourse.

climax.text: Warning signs: anonymous team, locked selling, unrealistic returns, and pressure to buy fast. If it feels wrong, it is.

punchline.text: They pull the rug. You hit the floor.

quiz.question: How much did rug pulls steal from investors in 2021?
